_note: Provisional domain -> color map. NOT a closed schema. Events store free-text cv_domain; this file only maps known strings to colorId. Observed from real weeks, not ratified. Add, rename, merge, drop freely — recolor pass updates the UI. Do not force events into listed keys.
_ceiling: Only 11 event colors exist. Cap COLORED domains at 11; cv_sub is unlimited. Unmapped cv_domain uses _fallback.
_fallback_rule: No mapped domain may reuse the _fallback colorId — otherwise unmapped domains render identically to a real one and the fallback stops being a visible signal.
_posture: flexible and adjustable — prefer a new string + fallback color over shoehorning into a listed domain
